title: Severely damaged road with multiple deep potholes
description: The road surface is heavily degraded, featuring numerous large and deep potholes, many of which are filled with water.
report: This report identifies a section of road in a severely damaged condition. The presence of numerous large potholes, some of which are filled with water, presents a serious hazard to all road users. The water-filled cavities obscure the true depth of the damage, increasing the risk of vehicle damage and loss of control. Immediate maintenance and repair are required to ensure public safety.
evidence: Multiple large, deep potholes are visible across the main roadway.
Potholes are filled with water, obscuring the actual depth and shape of the road damage.
The asphalt surface is uneven, fragmented, and shows extensive breakage.
risk: Potential for significant vehicle damage (tires, suspension) and an increased risk of accidents, particularly for two-wheeled vehicles navigating the uneven and obscured surface.
recommendedAction: Conduct an immediate inspection of the road section and carry out urgent pothole repairs and subsequent resurfacing.
